```php
namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Str;

class PasswordSeeder extends Seeder
{
    /**
     * Run the database seeds.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public function run()
    {
        // Seed the 'passwords' table to have fake user passwords
        for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
            $email = fake()->email();
            $password = Hash::make('password123'); // Fixed password for demonstration
            $created_at = now();

            // Insert fake user data into the 'users' table
            DB::table('users')->insert([
                'name' => fake()->name(),
                'email' => $email,
                'password' => $password,
                'remember_token' => Str::random(60),
                'created_at' => $created_at,
                'updated_at' => $created_at
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```
